name: Goretek FurLine Insulated Legging
description: A full-length thermal legging designed for fur geneware users who run cold despite their coat — a common complaint with short-fur mods that don't fully thermoregulate. The outer fabric is a brushed synth-fleece and the interior is slick-lined to prevent matting. The waistband folds down easily for tail-port layering under a trouser. Unglamorous but genuinely useful in Meridian winters.
functionality: Thermal insulation for under-thermoregulating fur mods; slick interior prevents fur matting; fold-down waistband enables tail-port layering
what_it_says: You've got the fur but not the heat — and you're practical enough to do something about it.
worn_by: people who layer under work trousers
story_hooks: A the Gray Zone-tier contact is wearing these — they're not cheap enough for the Gray Zone, which raises questions about where they came from.
The fold-down waistband has a hidden flat pocket just large enough for a folded paper note or a few small chips.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sleek, form-fitting full-length legging with a soft matte surface that reads as cozy and utilitarian. Streamlined silhouette that hugs the legs without restriction. Appears designed for layering under other garments rather than standalone wear.
physical_description.fit: Compression-adjacent but not restrictive; snug through hip and thigh, tapered at ankle. Designed to fit under trousers without bulk. Flexible waistband that folds down to accommodate tail-ports without puckering.
physical_description.primary_material: Brushed synth-fleece exterior (recycled polyester blend), slick nylon-analog interior lining to prevent fur matting and shedding.
physical_description.texture: Soft, brushed nap on outside; smooth, almost slippery to the touch on inside. Minimal pilling despite frequent wear and moisture exposure.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray base with darker heather undertones. Optional accent stitching in silver or gunmetal at seams. Some models feature subtle reflective piping at ankles for low-light visibility.
physical_description.closures: Folding elastic waistband with discrete magnetic closure side-seam; no visible hardware. Seamless ankle cuff that stays in place without constriction.
distinctive_features: Tail-port accommodation slot at lower back with reinforced edges
Interior thermal grid pattern embossed for moisture-wicking
Flatlock seams throughout to minimize irritation under fur
Discreet brand heat-stamp at inner waistband (no logo visibility)
Gusseted crotch panel for mobility and durability
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional — practical working-class augmentation accessory. Affordable durability rather than luxury.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by fur geneware users across lower-mid socioeconomic strata in cold-climate zones. Signals practical body modification acceptance and Meridian/northern GLMZ residency. Unglamorous but honest — marks wearer as someone who invested in mods for genuine lifestyle reasons, not corpo aesthetics.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in after first season; shows minor pilling at thigh friction points and faint discoloration from sweat/thermal cycling. Holds up well; typical lifespan 2-3 years before waistband elastic begins to slip.
